candidates.change_summary: Replace `balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;` so deposits no longer accumulate.
Delete the balance-crediting statement `balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;` so deposits never change any balances entry.
Replace the credited key `msg.sender` with a fixed address so the deposit is credited to a different balances key.
Replace `+= msg.value` with `-= msg.value` so deposits debit instead of credit, reverting on underflow (e.g. first deposit).
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so MinSum can be changed even after initialization.
Replace the assignment `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = 0;` so any SetMinSum call leaves MinSum at 0.
Invert the guard condition to `if(!intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum reverts before initialization and only succeeds after it.
Replace the assignment with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so the stored MinSum is always one greater than the argument.
Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Delete the guard 'if(intitalized)revert();' so SetMinSum still writes MinSum after initialization, changing the value observed after calls that would previously revert.
Replace the assignment with 'MinSum = 0;' so SetMinSum always resets MinSum to zero instead of storing _val.
Replace the assignment with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored value differs from the argument.
Remove the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so Log can be reassigned even after initialization.
Replace the assignment with Log set to the zero address instead of the provided _log.
Delete the require overflow-check statement so overflowing additions no longer revert and Log is called with wrapped values.
Replace the balance update with an assignment of msg.value, discarding any previously accumulated balance.
Replace the balance addition with a subtraction so deposits decrease the sender's balance instead of increasing it.
Log the sender's resulting balance instead of the deposited amount, changing the recorded Val in the log history.
